newsitem.title: FRANCE: Framatome says bids for Westinghouse unit.
newsitem.headline: Framatome says bids for Westinghouse unit.

text.p: French nuclear engineering company Framatome and GEC Alsthom have made separate but coordinated bids for the energy activities of Westinghouse Electric Corp, French daily les Echos said on Tuesday.

"In a separate but coordinated manner, Framatome has invited Westinghouse to discuss the possible acquisition of its nuclear division, and GEC Alsthom did the same for the conventional (energy) part," Les Echos quoted Framatome chairman Dominique Vignon as saying.
Vignon said the two companies made the offers in early August and had not yet received an answer.
"These are unsolicited offers to which Westinghouse has not yet answered. Other groups probably made the same type of offer," he was quoted as saying.
Earlier this month, Framatome said it was interested in the nuclear energy activities of Westinghouse, but said there had been no talks.
Vignon said a slowdown in the nuclear energy market will lead to new alliances and restructuring in the industry, and that Framatome wanted to be part of this process.
"With Westinghouse, we would obviously benefit from cost savings," he was quoted as saying.
